data.title: Price increase notice for internet tariff "Muster DSL 250"
data.summary: NetzMuster GmbH informs David Muster that the monthly base price of his "Muster DSL 250" internet tariff will rise from €39.99 to €44.99 starting 1 April 2026, and points out a special right to cancel the contract under § 57 TKG.
data.explanation: Your internet provider is raising the monthly price of your tariff. Because of this increase, German law gives you a special right to cancel the contract without notice period and without cost (Sonderkündigungsrecht, § 57 TKG). You don't have to do anything if you're fine with the new price — it will simply apply from the date stated. If you'd rather switch provider or cancel, the app will show you until when you can use this special cancellation right.
